content: Bhaai log, bestar hai kie iesaai me se na dher log samaadj me siekhaawe. Toelog djaane hai kie dje ekwan se auro djaada djaane hai, Parmeswar oke auro kara sotj-bietjaar se faisala kariega.
Hamlog sab koi har ek rakam se galtie kariela. Djab koi kabhie koetjh galtie na karat, tab oe na khaalie aapan moeh ekdam se samhaar paawat bakie aapan dehie aur tjaal-tjalan ke bhie.
Djab hamlog ek ghora ke moeh me ekgo lagaam pahienaaila, tab hamlog oke ekgo tjhota tjiedj se tjalaai sakiela.
Ek djahaadj aisane bhie hai. Oe barka hai aur barka hauwa se tjale hai, tabbo ek tjhota tjiedj se tjalaawal dja hai djaaha tjalaawe waala maange hai ledjaai.

Aisane moeh hamlogke dehie ke ek tjhota toekkara hai, aur tabbo bahoet barka baat bol sake hai. Aur djaise ek tjiengaarie djangal bhar djaraai sake hai, oisane moeh se har ek rakam kharaab tjiedj soeroe howe hai. Moeh hamlogke dehie ke toekkara hai djaun hamlogke ekdam se kasoerie banaawe hai. Hamlogke moeh se sab kharaabie to soeroe howe hai. Aur ie kharaabie saitaan lage se soeroe bhail hai.
Manai log sab rakam ke djanaawar ke samhaar paawe hai, djaise baagh, tjierai, saap-godjar aur samoendar ke djanaawar bhie.
Bakie koi na aapan moeh samhaar paawe hai. Moeh ekgo kharaab tjiedj hai djaun me se hardam ek na ek baat niekare hai. Oe to biekh se bharal hai doesare ke marwa dhaare ke.
Hamlog aapan moeh se Prabhoe ke aadar kariela, oe to hamlogke Pieta hai. Aur hamlog ohie moeh se bhie manai logan ke saraapiela tjaahe oesab Parmeswar ghat banaawal gail hai.
Aisane aasier-baat aur saraap ekahie moeh me se niekare hai. Bhaai logan, ie na thiek hai.
Ka, safa aur mail paanie ekahie dhaara me se niekar sake hai?

Bhaai log, ekgo aam ke per to amroed ke phal na dei sake hai. Aur ekgo narjar ke per to aam ke phal na dei sake hai. Aisane ekgo mail paanie ke dhaara me se safa paanie na niekar sake hai. Ohie se ekgo iesaai ke moeh me se na doei rakam baat niekare ke tjaahie.
Djab toelog me se koi ek sotj-bietjaar waala maange hai bolaawal djaai, tab oke tjaahie apane ke nietja karke aapan barhia tjaal-tjalan dekhaawe ke.
Bakie djab okar diel me djaran hai aur oe khaalie apane ke sotje hai, tab oke na tjaahie apane ke barwargie karke bole ke kie: „Ham ekgo sotj-bietjaar waala baatie.” Tab oe to djhoeth bole hai.
Aisan sotj-bietjaar Parmeswar ke or se na hai bakie iensaan logan ke. Ie sotj manai log ke kharaab diel me se niekare hai aur saitaan oelogse bolwaawe hai.
Djaaha manai log doesare ke djaran kare hai aur khaalie apane ke sotje hai, taaha sab koetjh tjhiettier-biettier tjale hai aur sab rakam ke doesar kharaab tjiedj bhie howe hai.

Bakie dje Parmeswar ke gjaan par tjale hai, oe pahiela dardja par safa se sotj-bietjaar kare hai. Oe doesare se attjha se aur kaida se rahe hai. Oe doesare khaatien mar-miete hai aur oelogke daaja kare hai, aur oe bhala kaam karat rahe hai. Oe koi ke moeh na taake hai aur oe moehe-moeh par baat kare hai.
Aur dje doesar log ke phien se ek karwaawe hai, oe doesare sanghe miel-djoelke rahe hai aur ek bhala kaam karies hai.
